overview_description.description:
We see a world where every financial institution makes financial health a KPI. 

Today, we help credit unions operate through the lens of financial health:
 - Set strategic plans at the board level with financial health at the core of purpose, vision, and mission
 - Market to prospects based on their unique financial health needs and your unique solutions
 - Develop your product roadmap based on what’s going to drive the largest improvement in member financial health
 - Create member experiences designed to uplift financial health at every turn - even when denying a loan
 - Build your compensation and benefits around employee financial health: when you take care of your employees, your employees take care of your members, and your members take care of the credit union
 - Help your SEGs help their employees with employee financial health to accelerate your mission and your business development

We are your one-stop shop for making financial health and wellbeing for all actionable at every level, from financial service representatives to board members.

product.name: FinHealth Workflow™

product.name: FinHealth Score® Assessment and Scoring Engine

product.name: Enterprise FinHealth Infrastructure
product.description: Developer-focused infrastructure that lets financial-services and insurance companies embed financial health diagnosis, outcome tracking, and benchmarking into their products through APIs and other integration methods.

identifier.value: Financial Health Outcomes, Benchmarking, and Reporting Services

product.name: Financial Health Outcomes, Benchmarking, and Reporting Services
